description: Enhanced descriptions for merchant-configurable properties that cannot be automatically extracted from source code or READMEs.

urlpath.description: Specifies the category path to display products from. Use this to create category-specific product listing pages. For example, `/women/dresses` shows products from the dresses category.
urlpath.when_to_use: Set this when creating a dedicated category page. Leave empty for search result pages.

showHistory.description: Controls whether to show company credit transaction history ('true') or only credit summary information ('false'). Set to `true` to enable this feature. Default: `true`
